interface P2 { x: number; y: number }
interface P3 { x: number; y: number; z: number }
const p3 = { x: 1, y: 2, z: 3 };
const copy: P2 = { ...p3 };
console.log(copy);
function mk(): P3 { return { x: 1, y: 2, z: 3 }; }
function show(p: P2) { console.log(p); }
show({ ...mk() });
const c: P2 = { ...{ x: 1, y: 2, z: 3 } };
console.log(c);
function pick(u: { x: number; y: number; k: 1 } | { x: number; y: number; k: 2 }) {
  const e: P2 = { ...u, x: 0 };
  console.log(e);
}
pick({ x: 5, y: 6, k: 2 });
